visualCharacteristics: Grey box with a coloured left rule, a circle-info icon on the left (CSS mask SVG, no icon font) and a short rich-text paragraph.
contentPattern: Single cell of rich text. The option class selects the note type and icon; information is the default when no type class is set. New types: add to NOTE_TYPES in note.js, an icon rule in note.css and an option in _note.json.

usage.description: Informational notice, e.g. the OS-update note shared via the fragment /en/support/downloads/drivers/fragments/os-update-note.

reuseGuidance: Use for short callouts/notices. Put notes repeated across pages in a fragment and embed with the Fragment block.
